name: Yokujou Tomarunners ~Elmeros wa Zecchou Shita~
original_name: 欲情トマランナーズ ～エルメロスは絶頂した～
source:
The girls ran. Toward what, they did not care. 

Herm-Eros was outraged. 
Her longtime friend Celentius was captured by the cunning king!

Before Celentius was executed Herm-Eros would do everything in her power to 
make it to the kingdom in time. 

She ran. 

Skilled with a sword, nothing would stand in her way! 

...... Meanwhile, Celentius had slipped from her chains and was escaping the kingdom. 

She ran. 

With powerful legs she could evade any danger, without doubt! 

The girls ran. But they didn't know what lay ahead. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105811.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
女孩们跑了。为了什么，他们并不关心。

赫姆-爱神勃然大怒。
她的老朋友塞伦提乌斯被狡猾的国王俘虏了！

在塞伦提乌斯被处决之前，赫姆-爱洛斯会尽其所能 
及时到达王国。

她跑了。

剑术高强，没有什么可以阻挡她！

…… 与此同时，塞伦提乌斯挣脱了锁链，逃离了王国。

她跑了。

凭借有力的双腿，她可以躲避任何危险，这是毫无疑问的！

女孩们跑了。但他们不知道接下来会发生什么。
